summary: Redesigned the Settings → Users tab to match myiotsan's admin user-management pattern: a scannable `DataTable` (initials avatar + name/@username, a colour-coded role badge, an active/inactive status pill, and a pending-password-change indicator) replaces the old two-panel layout of a separate "add user" form plus a wall of inline-editable user cards. Add and edit now happen behind a modal dialog (`UserModal`), with reset-password folded into the same edit modal instead of a per-card inline field. The new `UsersManager` component (in `apps/mymatasan/views/react-webpack/src/views/components/settings.js`) is self-contained — it owns its own fetch/state, following the same pattern already used by `StockModelPanel` — so the now-dead user-CRUD plumbing (`users`/`newUser`/`passwordDrafts` state, `loadUsers`/`createUser`/`editUser`/`updateUser`/`resetUserPassword`/`deleteUser` handlers, and their props into `SettingsTab`) was removed from `App.js`. New i18n keys (`st.usersHint`, `st.user`, `st.status`, `st.editUser`, `st.activeAccount`, `st.resetPwHint`, `st.deleteUserTitle`, `st.deleteUserBody`) were added to all four locales (en/ms/zh/ar). The old `.user-card`/`.user-list` CSS was replaced with new table/badge/pill/modal styles in `app.css`. Purely presentational — no backend or API changes; the same `/api/settings/users` (list/create/update/delete) and `/api/settings/users/{id}/password` endpoints are called with the same payload shapes.
compatibility: Backward-compatible for every existing install: no config, schema, RBAC, or API contract changed, so nothing needs migrating. Existing accounts, roles, and permissions behave identically; only the on-screen presentation of the Users tab and the add/edit interaction (modal instead of inline form) changed. No admin action required.
